messages:
maria: quick sync on embeddings UI — focus on batch input UX, table layout, vector preview, and export permutations. dropped updated mock: https://figma.redwood/emb-batch-v2. 15-20 min reads appreciated.

oliver: skimmed. two high-level layout questions: sticky header for column filters? and should vector dim be hidden by default?

devon: sticky header yes for long lists. hide vector dim column by default, make it toggleable in column picker. performance: table virtualization + row expansion to render previews on demand.

sunita: batch input flows: we need three entry points — quick paste, CSV upload, and API import. show a small sample preview after upload with detected delimiter and encoding. add a small "fix encoding" helper.

kevin: accessibility notes: column picker must be keyboard operable; filters should announce applied filters. when we hide vector dims they still need to be available to screen readers via a details panel.
maria: copy nit: current placeholder says "Enter texts" 14 change to "Paste texts (one per line) or upload CSV". also add helper link "format examples".

oliver: vector preview placement: propose a right-side drawer for preview to avoid occluding table. drawer can be pinned. preview shows top-k nearest matches and a small sparklines row for similarity across top-k.

devon: drawer is fine. also add a toggle for showing vectors as numbers vs compact base64 string. but default to "numbers" for easier debug.

sunita: privacy/regulatory: for non-admin users mask vectors by default and show a tooltip "Vectors hidden for your role. Request access." add an audit log entry when a user downloads vectors.

kevin: export options: CSV (no vectors), CSV+vectors (numeric arrays), CSV+vectors(base64), NDJSON, Parquet. UI should recommend NDJSON for large exports and Parquet for analytics. add a small size estimate for chosen format and a checkbox: "Compress output (.gz)" with estimated compressed size.
maria: wording for export confirmation: "Include vectors in export? Vectors can be large and may contain sensitive information. Download size estimate: ~{estimate}." default unchecked. include a link to export policy.

oliver: on the export modal show sample header row that will be produced (Rank, id, text, snippet, score, vector?). let users reorder columns with drag handle for final export.

devon: implementation detail: server should accept column order and compression flag and schedule background job. return a one-time signed URL. UI shows job id and progress. for big jobs show ETA.
sunita: re-run failed rows flow: after a batch run, allow a CSV of failed rows with error codes. show buttons: Retry selected, Export fails. include an option to skip duplicates.

kevin: keyboard shortcuts proposal: R to rerank focused row, E to export selection, / to focus search. ensure they are discoverable in a shortcut modal.
maria: rerank UX: small inline spinner for instant rerank; for >200 rows default to background rerank with toast and email. show "estimated cost" and "estimated time" in rerank confirm modal.
oliver: multi-select actions: allow bulk preview and bulk exclude. consider rate limits when previewing many vectors 14 throttle client requests.
devon: for vector preview drawer include an "open in isolated viewer" that loads a full page projection with brush selection for scatter plots. that helps debugging cluster issues.
sunita: export schema link: provide JSON schema + human-readable columns doc. also include example rows (1-3) in the modal for clarity.

kevin: a11y-bot: automated check suggestion: ensure table rows have role=row and cells role=cell; ARIA live region for background job completion. color mapping for buckets should be >= 3:1 for graphics and have patterns for tiny bars.
maria: final checklist for handoff: 1) drawer preview + pin, 2) column picker with vector dim hidden by default, 3) paste/upload/API batch flows + encoding detection, 4) re-run fails and export fails CSV, 5) export modal with format, compression, sample headers, and size estimate, 6) background job with signed URL + ETA + audit log, 7) keyboard shortcuts + accessibility pass, 8) role-based vector masking and copy text updates.
oliver: can we also add a micro-interaction for copy vector: small toast "vector copied" and copy button should be aria-live to announce success.
devon: i'll prototype the drawer and background export modal. will include fake size estimates for the mock.
sunita: i'll draft the export policy blurb and schema docs.

kevin: i'll run a quick keyboard/a11y checklist and post notes. will ping on PR review. :thumbsup:

maria: perfect 14 please add reactions when you approve and i'll create tickets.
oliver: :thumbsup:
devon: :thumbsup:
sunita: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
a11y-bot: automated report: contrast and focus-order passed on header and modal. suggested fixes for data table aria-live for long exports.
